hypothesis: Invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC) lacks validated subtype-specific early detection biomarkers because current TCGA-derived molecular classifiers are predominantly trained on invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC). Two orthogonal ILC-specific biosignatures — (1) ferroptosis-related gene signature (FRGS, 2-subtype consensus clustering from TCGA+METABRIC+GEO, n=490) and (2) TME-driven spatial transcriptomics subtypes (43 HR+/HER2- ILC tumors, PNAS 2026) — provide a foundation for a multi-modal ILC biomarker panel. Combining FRGS components as liquid biopsy markers (cell-free RNA / ctDNA methylation) with TME-subtype stratification may enable ILC-specific early detection and predict differential CDK4/6 inhibitor response by histology (as suggested by PALMARES-2 real-world data).

evidence.claim: 490-patient multi-dataset (TCGA+METABRIC+GEO) study identifies 2 ILC ferroptosis subtypes via consensus clustering; machine-learning FRGS shows prognostic significance and links to TME/mutation landscape
Spatial transcriptomics of 43 HR+/HER2- ILC tumors reveals TME-driven subtypes; PNAS 2026 confirms current molecular classifications overlook ILC spatial complexity
Real-world PALMARES-2 Italian cohort: CDK4/6 inhibitor effectiveness differs by tumor histology (ILC vs IDC), providing clinical validation that ILC requires subtype-specific treatment stratification

novelty_claim: The specific combination of ferroptosis-gene-signature classification with spatial TME subtyping as a composite liquid biopsy panel for ILC has not been proposed in the retrieved literature. Both components were published independently in early 2026. The link to differential CDK4/6 inhibitor response (PALMARES-2) adds a therapeutic prediction dimension not present in either source paper.
actionability: Next experiment: test whether the FRGS genes (from Liu et al. TCGA model) show differential methylation signatures in ILC vs IDC cell-free DNA datasets (e.g., TCGA WGBS data or GEO cfDNA cohorts). Use biomedical-fetch clinicaltrials_search to identify active ILC-specific liquid biopsy trials as comparators. If FRGS methylation differs detectably in cfDNA, propose a validation study design for lobular-specific early detection.
candidate_biomarkers: Ferroptosis-related gene expression panel (FRGS — specific genes TBD from full Liu et al. supplementary)
CDH1 (E-cadherin) — canonical ILC loss marker; already known but not yet in validated liquid biopsy format
TME subtype-defining spatial transcripts (from Serra et al. — immune cold vs immune hot ILC subtypes)
CDK4/6 inhibitor response stratification markers (histology-adjusted, from PALMARES-2)
gap_identified: No validated ILC-specific early detection or MRD (minimal residual disease) liquid biopsy panel exists. All 144 ILC papers returned by primary search use bulk tissue or TCGA datasets; none use cfRNA or ctDNA in ILC-specific contexts.
